items.title: Hackers Hide Vasilek Backdoor Inside VMware Tools to Target Medical Organizations
items.description: Hackers concealed the Vasilek backdoor inside an existing VMware Tools installation during a prolonged intrusion at a medical organization. The attackers maintained access for approximately two years, exposing sensitive medical information while leaving systems operational rather than launching a destructive attack. The earliest evidence dates to early 2024. Investigators found signs of remote…

Daniel Rhyne, 59, of Kansas City, Missouri, received the sentence on September 28, 2026, in federal court in Trenton. items.description: A new campaign targeting ad account managers uses fake ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity sites that steal login credentials and multi-factor authentication (MFA) codes through browser-in-browser attacks. [...]
